# `{CoReview}`

## Installation

You can install the development version of
[CoReview](https://github.com/MUHEG/CoReview) like so:

``` r

# (Only necessary if the remotes package is not installed).
utils::install.packages("remotes")
```

``` r

remotes::install_github("MUHEG/CoReview")
```

## Run

You can launch the application by running:

``` r

CoReview::run_app()
```

# Package index

## Functions

- [`combine_reviewed()`](https://MUHEG.github.io/CoReview/reference/combine_reviewed.md)
  : Combine reviewed batches into the final verified deliverables.
- [`run_app()`](https://MUHEG.github.io/CoReview/reference/run_app.md) :
  Run the Shiny Application
- [`split_for_review()`](https://MUHEG.github.io/CoReview/reference/split_for_review.md)
  : Split AI extraction/QA output into per-reviewer batch folders.
